mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and can potentiate duloxetine's effects on serotonin and norepinephrine; both drugs may increase seizure risk and affect cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely, assess renal function regularly, and watch for signs of hypomagnesemia or hypocalcemia; consider alternative antiviral if possible or use lowest effective duloxetine dose.
